menu.heading: Menu items
menu.hint: Tap + to add. What you add moves to the order panel.

order.heading: Added to order
order.emptyBody: Pick dishes from the menu. They land here, with quantities and notes.

orderEdit.title: Edit {{round}} - table {{code}}

intro.SENT: The kitchen has not started this order. Your changes reach the kitchen screen marked as edited.
intro.DRAFT: This order has not been sent yet, so the changes apply to the draft.

lock.heading: This order can no longer be edited
lock.KITCHEN_STARTED: The kitchen has started this order, so it can no longer be edited. Cancel the items that are still waiting or add a new round instead.
lock.ORDER_SERVED: This order has been served, so it can no longer be edited.
lock.ORDER_CANCELLED: This order was cancelled, so it can no longer be edited.
lock.SESSION_NOT_OPEN: The table session is closed, so this order can no longer be edited.
lock.INVOICE_EXISTS: A bill has been generated for this table. Void the bill first if the order really has to change.
lock.unknown: This order can no longer be edited.

orderEdit.loading: Loading the latest version of the order
orderEdit.emptyBlocked: An order must keep at least one item. Cancel the whole order instead.
orderEdit.reasonPlaceholder: For example: guest asked for one more

notice.conflict: Someone else changed this order while you were editing. The latest version is loaded and your changes are kept where they still apply. Review them, then save again.
notice.live: This order was updated by someone else. The latest version is shown and your changes are kept.
notice.dropped_one: {{count}} of your changes no longer applies because that line was removed elsewhere.
notice.dropped_other: {{count}} of your changes no longer apply because those lines were removed elsewhere.
notice.lockedMidEdit: This order can no longer be edited, so your changes were not saved.

errors.save: Could not save the changes. Nothing was changed; try again.
errors.refresh: Could not reload the order. Check the connection and try again.
errors.keyReused: That edit could not be matched. Review the order and save again.
